name: Near East Original Plain Couscous (100% Semolina)
whyItWorks: Tiny pearls of precooked durum wheat semolina. When covered in boiling broth, it steams fluffy and soft in just 5 minutes. Exceptionally gentle on digestion with minimal chew required.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bring 1 cup chicken bone broth to a boil, stir in 1 cup couscous, remove from heat and cover for 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
